data.name: Royal Odyssey
data.detailed_description:
Important update today regarding the future of our debut title, Royal Odyssey. After careful consideration, we’ve decided to move the game’s release into 2026. This decision wasn’t made lightly, but it comes from a place of ambition and belief in what the game can become.

Here’s what this means for you, the players:

  • A Bolder Experience: Royal Odyssey is evolving far beyond it's original vision. What started as a simple space shooter is becoming something much more dynamic and more memorable. We want this to be more than just another game. We want it to be an experience worth your time.

  • Polish and Presentation: Every detail matters, from gameplay mechanics to the overall presentation. This additional time allows us to refine, expand and deliver the game at a level of quality we know it can achieve.

  • Building Momentum: We’re committed not only to making a great game, but also to giving it the visibility and excitement it deserves. This extended timeline ensures that when Royal Odyssey launches, it will launch with impact.

We deeply appreciate the feedback and encouragement we’ve received so far. Your passion has fueled our progress, and it will continue to guide us as we take this next step forward. Thank you for being part of the journey. We look forward to sharing more updates, reveals and behind-the-scenes looks as we move closer to launch in 2026. Stay tuned! The best is yet to come.

About This Game:

Take to the stars as Prince Zayven in Royal Odyssey, a retro-styled arcade space shooter inspired by classics such as Galaga. Maneuver through a relentless asteroid storm, overcome chaotic environmental hazards and unlock devastating power-ups as you fight to save your kingdom. Featuring dynamic movement, strategic combat, online leaderboards and an asteroid boss encounter, Royal Odyssey brings high-score chasing and retro intensity into 2025. Can you survive the storm?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 620 / GeForce GT 710 / Radeon R5 240
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card or onboard audio
  • Additional Notes: Stereo speakers recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 550
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card or onboard audio
  • Additional Notes: Stereo speakers recommended
